title: Creative Origins
description: A modpack based around origins and create.
body:
A mod based around origins and create.

____________________________________
Awakening in a new world you find yourself different you are no longer a human but something else you have a desire to create to explore and discover you can create things thought to be impossible.

_____________________________________

Features

Origins:
play as many types of origins from the origins mod origins+ and 3 custom origins made by me.

create:
build giant factories with create automate everything use valkarian skies with create clockwork to fly through the sky.

exploration:
wander through many new unique biomes through oh the biomes we've gone explore new structures through dungeons and taverns.

quality of life:
there are many mods to add to quality of life like appleskin and iris shaders as well as mouse tweaks to make the expirience more enjoyable for everyone.
